bead.title: concerns: apply go-std lint reconciliation (path A restore linters OR path B amend concern override)
bead.description:
PROBLEM: .ddx/plugins/helix/workflows/concerns/go-std/practices.md declares a golangci-lint baseline (govet, staticcheck, ineffassign, misspell, unconvert, gosec, gocritic) that is not reflected in .golangci.yml (which enables only misspell). The Makefile partially compensates via go vet, gosec, govulncheck, go test -race pre-push. Repo state is internally inconsistent — this bead resolves it.

ROOT CAUSE: Same as parent (AR Open Decisions §1, fizeau-a1b61f00). The sibling audit bead produces the gap mapping; this bead acts on it by selecting and executing exactly one resolution path.

PROPOSED FIX: Consume the audit artifact produced by the sibling bead, choose exactly one path, and execute it end to end:
  Path A — In .golangci.yml (linters block), restore the declared set (add govet, staticcheck, ineffassign, unconvert, gosec, gocritic; keep misspell). Carry forward exclusions verbatim from the audit (AC4 of sibling). Wire `golangci-lint run ./...` into the pre-push gate (lefthook.yml pre-push stage) and/or any existing CI workflow file under .github/workflows that mirrors Makefile lint targets.
  Path B — Add an override paragraph to docs/helix/01-frame/concerns.md §go-std that ratifies the Makefile-driven equivalents. The paragraph must name each of the seven declared linters and the specific Makefile target / tool that replaces it (1:1, using the audit mapping), and state why each substitution is accepted.

NON-SCOPE: Do not execute both paths. Do not modify the upstream .ddx/plugins/helix/workflows/concerns/go-std/practices.md — overrides belong in the project's docs/helix/01-frame/concerns.md. Do not re-produce the audit mapping; consume the sibling bead's output. Do not introduce new linters beyond the declared baseline.

GOVERNING ARTIFACTS: AR-2026-05-17-repo open decision §1 (fizeau-a1b61f00); .ddx/plugins/helix/workflows/concerns/go-std/practices.md; docs/helix/01-frame/concerns.md; .golangci.yml; Makefile; lefthook.yml.

DEPENDENCIES: Sibling audit bead (go-std-lint-audit mapping artifact) must be merged before this bead is executable.

VERIFICATION: Exactly one path executed; chosen artifact internally consistent with practices.md and with current Makefile/.golangci.yml state; pre-push gate green; if path A, golangci-lint run is clean on HEAD.
bead.acceptance:
AC1 (TestGoStdReconciliationPathSelected): Exactly one path (A or B) is taken; the PR body records the choice and cites the audit row(s) that justify it.
AC2a Path A (TestGolangciConfigEnablesDeclaredBaseline): If path A, .golangci.yml's linters block enables govet, staticcheck, ineffassign, misspell, unconvert, gosec, gocritic; exclusions are present verbatim from the sibling audit (AC4); `golangci-lint run ./...` exits 0 on current HEAD.
AC2b Path A CI wiring (TestGolangciInPrePushGate): If path A, `lefthook run pre-push` invokes golangci-lint (or the equivalent .github/workflows file is updated) and the gate is green.
AC3b Path B (TestConcernsOverrideNamesEachReplacement): If path B, docs/helix/01-frame/concerns.md §go-std contains an override paragraph that names each of the seven declared linters and the specific Makefile target/tool replacing it; no declared linter is unaddressed; rationale matches audit gap notes.
AC4 Internal consistency (TestGoStdArtifactInternallyConsistent): After the change, no contradiction remains between .golangci.yml, Makefile, lefthook.yml, and docs/helix/01-frame/concerns.md §go-std (cross-references resolve).
AC5 Gates: `go test ./... -race` passes; `lefthook run pre-push` passes; under path A additionally `golangci-lint run ./...` exits 0; under path B the override paragraph passes any markdown lint configured in lefthook.
